title: Ind-smoothness after total-fraction localization
statement: Assume that every regular map from a field k in universe u to a Noetherian k-algebra L in universe max(u,v) presents L as a filtered colimit of smooth k-algebras [def-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-smooth-algebras]. For a nonzero reduced Noetherian ring R in universe u and a regular R-algebra Λ in universe max(u,v), with Λ Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-g-ring, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let S be the nonzerodivisors of R. Then S^{-1}Λ is a filtered colimit of smooth S^{-1}R-algebras [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map, def-weil-pbc-module-localization], with the algebras and index category in universe max(u,v).

proof.text: Apply total_fraction_fiber_decomposition to R and Λ, obtaining a finite enumeration q of the minimal primes and compatible isomorphisms from the localized base to ∏ κ(q_i) and the localized target to ∏ q_i.Fiber Λ. This construction does not use the field-case hypothesis or regularity.

For each q_i, unfold RingHom.IsRegular and toAlgebra_algebraMap to extract geometric regularity of its fibre. Its Noetherianity is the first clause. A geometrically regular k-algebra A over a field gives a regular map k → A: flatness is automatic, and for a prime p of k use p.algEquivResidueFieldOfField to identify its fibre with A. For every finite purely inseparable extension L of the residue field, restrict scalars to k; the canonical field isomorphism is finite and purely inseparable, so these properties compose. Apply geometric regularity over k and cancel the intermediate base change with Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange. This proves geometric regularity of the only fibre, hence regularity of k → A. Apply the assumed field case to each residue-field fibre.

Apply Algebra.ind_smooth_of_finite_product to the compatible decomposition and the component presentations from the preceding step. This yields the required presentation over Localization R⁰ in universe max(u,v).

theorem localized_target_is_ind_smooth
    (h : ∀ (k : Type u) (Λ : Type (max u v)) [Field k] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ]
      [IsNoetherianRing Λ],
      RingHom.IsRegular (algebraMap k Λ) →
        ObjectProperty.ind.{max u v}
          (fun B : CommAlgCat.{max u v} k ↦ Algebra.Smooth k B)
          (CommAlgCat.of k Λ))
    (R : Type u) (Λ : Type (max u v)) [CommRing R] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra R Λ]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Nontrivial R] [IsReduced R]
    (hreg : RingHom.IsRegular (algebraMap R Λ)) :
    ObjectProperty.ind.{max u v}
      (fun B : CommAlgCat.{max u v} (Localization R⁰) ↦
        Algebra.Smooth (Localization R⁰) B)
      (CommAlgCat.of (Localization R⁰)
        (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid Λ R⁰)))
